## `neuro.atob`

Static method on `globalThis`.

> [MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Window/atob)

## Signatures

```ts
atob(input: { data: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `globalThis.atob` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code
  lang="ts"
  code={atob("")}
  wrap
/>
